resources.string: Enable or disable all automations. Disabling cancels active rules.
If the system hook delivers 12 power-key releases in 10 seconds, stop and disable all rules. Not guaranteed on every ROM; use the master switch as backup.
Toast Android KeyCode and scan code from the chosen input source when a physical key is released.
Reuse the libsu Root shell for approved read-only queries. Commands with side effects always use independent cancellable processes.
Executable path for YAuto Root commands. Use su or an absolute path ending with /su. A custom executable disables the libsu shared route.
Not enabled: YAuto uses a scoped LSPosed SystemUI bridge instead of granting the entire com.android.shell or SystemUI process Root.
Save reusable Shell, JavaScript, MVEL and BeanShell snippets, and package-name sets locally. Copy the content into automation actions; the library does not execute code by itself.
Emergency stop is active. Enable Rule feature to resume.
Root is available. Shizuku is disabled by the privileged routing policy; no authorization is needed.
YAuto emergency stop: all rules disabled
